timeline.summary: Monoists attack the Dawnsire; Slats prophesies Vondam's death and Alpharael throws the bead through his head, apparently killing him.
timeline.quote: it went directly through Syr Vondam's head, apparently killing him

citation.text: "Vondam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Monoists kill Sothera into a supervoid rather than let it explode into a supernova.
timeline.quote: So, they killed the star.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Monoists capture Sothera's collapse and turn it inward into a supervoid, making it their thousandth.
timeline.quote: Sothera is that thousandth supervoid.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Monoists settle Anuki and rename it Susur Secundi.
timeline.quote: It has been decades since the Monoists settled Anuki and renamed it Susur Secundi

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Palatinate sends Sunstar Free Company knights to stop the Monoists and deploy a horizon javelin at Sothera.
timeline.quote: the Palatinate has dispatched a force of Sunstar Free Company knights to drive the Monoists out and deploy one of their javelins

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Raphaella's final transmission explains the Monoist purpose, describes the Dawnsire and Candela, and bids farewell as her inevitor falls toward Sothera.
timeline.quote: that we will destroy the Dawnsire

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael wakes from the nightmare and a steward tells him his sister's inevitor completed its transit, proving that inevitors can penetrate the Free Company's defenses.
timeline.quote: Her flight has proven that an infalling inevitor can penetrate the Free Company's defenses.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael says he wants to die and asks to join the next assault on the Dawnsire.
timeline.quote: Tell them I want to go in with the next wave,

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A rahu blesses the strike cadre and gives Alpharael a sekhar bead.
timeline.quote: The rahu gives Alpharael a microvoid trapped in a bead.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya's bind discusses the expected Monoist suicide attack.
timeline.quote: So, they need an unreasonable way, a way that makes no sense: throw people at the problem and hope one of them manages something.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Kavaron's degradation poisoned hearts, which the Monoists exploited.
timeline.quote: Kavaron's degradation poisoned many hearts, which the Monoists were happy to exploit.

citation.text: Mutinous Massacre (Edge of Eternities, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Monoists coerce Sothera's dying star into becoming a supervoid.
timeline.quote: a dying star which was coerced into becoming a supervoid by Monoists

citation.text: "Edge", section "Astrography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Forces vie for cosmic power in the Sothera system around an unstable supervoid at its center.
timeline.quote: Harness the advanced technology of the Sothera system as forces vie for cosmic power

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Monoists, Summists and Eldrazi converge on the station for the stone; the crew uses the station to warp them out into the Wurmwall.
timeline.quote: but they managed to use the station to warp them out into the Wurmwall.

citation.text: "Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Monoists attack the Dawnsire; Vondam and Haliya help lead the defense, and Slats prophesies Vondam's death.
timeline.quote: it was attacked by a strike cadre of Monoists

citation.text: "Haliya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The crew takes the Endstone to Infinite Guideline Station, uses the station to warp enemies into the Wurmwall, and Sami recovers Mirri.
timeline.quote: they managed to use the station to warp them out into the Wurmwall

citation.text: "Sami", section "Hunt for the Endstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The first Astelli flee the Monoists' expansion, which collapses stars into supervoids and overwhelms less-advanced civilizations.
timeline.quote: The Monoists consumed many refugee stars, collapsing them into supervoids as they chased the Astelli and grew their dominion.

citation.text: "Astelli", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hundreds of Astelli make a stand against the Monoists and die.
timeline.quote: Their first attempt to fight back saw hundreds of Astelli standing alone against the advancing Monoists

citation.text: "Astelli", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A Monoist strike cadre attacked Dawnsire; invaders defeated but Captain Slats allowed Alpharael to escape.
timeline.quote: Captain Slats allowed the Monoist Alpharael to escape

citation.text: "Dawnsire", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Monoists collapse Sothera into a supervoid, slowing the system's death.
timeline.quote: giving the Kav time to leave their planet

citation.text: "Kavaronic Federal Empire", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A battle at the station; Sami's group warps enemies into the Wurmwall and Sami recovers Mirri.
timeline.quote: Sami also recovered their missing cat Mirri from a stasis cask aboard the station

citation.text: "Mission for the Endstone", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Monoists induce Sothera's quiet collapse into a supervoid.
timeline.quote: inducing its quiet collapse into a supervoid

citation.text: "Sothera", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Pinnacle opened Sothera, the Monoists came to Anuki, were elated at its labyrinths and claimed it; the Kav did not contest.
timeline.quote: The Kav did not contest their claim.

citation.text: "Susur Secundi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Monoists rename Anuki Susur Secundi and make it their main staging ground in the Sothera system.
timeline.quote: the main staging ground for Monoists in the Sothera system

citation.text: "Susur Secundi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dawnsire fires on Monastery Singul after a Monoist strike on the spacecraft.
timeline.quote: Was fired upon by Dawnsire after a Monoist strike on the spacecraft

citation.text: "Susur Secundi", section "Known locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
